overview: This 738-page file traces Japan’s wartime financing and postwar financial reconstruction through 1948. It covers occupation fiscal policy, inflation, foreign bondholder claims, Swiss securities declarations, liquidation of corporate shares, rehabilitation and cotton credits, and sterling trade arrangements. Correspondence, policy papers, directives, economic forecasts, and detailed sales tables show how officials balanced recovery, debt obligations, foreign property rights, and control of Japanese finance.
interest: Detailed bond ownership declarations and securities sales tables reveal how occupation reforms affected foreign investors and Japan’s recovery.
